steel-pipes.title: Steel Pipes
steel-pipes.summary: Seamless and welded pipes for transmission lines and industrial applications.
steel-pipes.keywords: steel pipe seamless welded carbon steel API 5L A106 line pipe
steel-pipes.intro: Carbon, alloy and stainless steel pipes in two groups — seamless and welded — for transporting oil, gas, water and process fluids. The choice of pipe depends on design pressure, temperature, fluid, diameter and the project's standard requirements.

types.name: Seamless
types.desc: Suited to high pressure and temperature and to critical process lines.

types.name: Electric resistance welded (ERW)
types.desc: Economical for small and medium diameters in transmission lines and structures.

types.name: Longitudinal seam (LSAW)
types.desc: Large diameters and heavy walls for main transmission lines.

types.name: Spiral seam (SSAW)
types.desc: Large diameters for water transmission and lower-pressure applications.

specs.label: Common standards
specs.value: API 5L · ASTM A106 · ASTM A53 · ASTM A333 · ASTM A312

specs.label: Grade
specs.value: API 5L Gr.B to X70 · A106 Gr.B/C · A333 Gr.6 · TP304/316L

specs.label: Diameter range
specs.value: NPS ½ to 48 in (depending on manufacturing method)

specs.label: Wall thickness / schedule
specs.value: SCH 10 to SCH 160 · STD · XS · XXS

specs.label: Pipe ends
specs.value: Plain (PE) · Bevelled (BE) · Threaded (TE)

specs.label: Coating
specs.value: Bare · Galvanized · 3LPE / FBE on request

fittings.title: Industrial Fittings
fittings.summary: Elbows, tees, reducers and the fittings a pipeline needs.
fittings.keywords: industrial fittings elbow tee reducer cap butt weld socket weld threaded B16.9
fittings.intro: Butt-weld and forged (socket-weld and threaded) fittings for changing direction, branching and changing diameter in pipelines. The material and wall thickness of a fitting must match the pipe it joins.

types.name: Elbow
types.desc: 45° and 90°, long radius (LR) and short radius (SR), and 180° returns.

types.name: Tee
types.desc: Equal and reducing, for branching off the main line.

types.name: Caps and forged fittings
types.desc: End caps, couplings, nipples and Class 3000 and 6000 fittings.

specs.label: Common standards
specs.value: ASME B16.9 · ASME B16.11 · MSS SP-75 · MSS SP-97

specs.label: Material
specs.value: ASTM A234 WPB · A420 WPL6 · A403 WP304/316 · A105 (forged)

specs.label: Diameter range
specs.value: Butt weld: ½ to 48 in · Forged: ⅛ to 4 in

specs.label: Wall thickness / class
specs.value: To pipe schedule (SCH) · Forged Class 3000 / 6000 / 9000

specs.label: End connection
specs.value: Butt weld (BW) · Socket weld (SW) · Threaded (NPT)

flanges.title: Flanges & Accessories
flanges.summary: Flanges and joint components to the requested class, material and standard.
flanges.keywords: flange steel class gasket stud bolt nut B16.5 weld neck slip-on blind
flanges.intro: Flanges allow a line to be opened and closed for repair and inspection. The flange pressure class must be chosen according to design pressure, temperature and material; gaskets and bolting are part of the same assembly.

types.name: Weld neck
types.desc: The most common type for high pressure, high temperature and cyclic loads.

types.name: Socket weld, threaded and lap joint
types.desc: For small diameters or where rotation and easy dismantling are needed.

specs.label: Common standards
specs.value: ASME B16.5 (up to 24 in) · ASME B16.47 Series A/B (26 to 60 in) · EN 1092-1

specs.label: Facing
specs.value: Raised face (RF) · Flat face (FF) · Ring-type joint (RTJ)

specs.label: Accessories
specs.value: Spiral-wound and ring gaskets (ASME B16.20) · A193 B7 stud bolts and A194 2H nuts

applications: Connecting pipe to valves and equipment

valves.title: Valves & Equipment
valves.summary: Supply of control equipment and complementary items for pipelines.
valves.keywords: valves equipment instrumentation gate ball check butterfly globe API 6D
valves.intro: Industrial valves for isolation, flow control and preventing backflow. The valve type, pressure class, body and trim materials and actuator type must suit the fluid and operating conditions.

types.name: Gate
types.desc: Full isolation with low pressure drop.

types.name: Ball
types.desc: Quick shut-off and reliable sealing; common on gas transmission lines.

types.name: Check
types.desc: Prevents backflow; swing, lift and dual-plate.

types.name: Globe / Butterfly
types.desc: Flow regulation, or isolation in large diameters.

specs.label: Common standards
specs.value: API 6D · API 600 · API 602 · API 608 · API 609 · ASME B16.34

specs.label: Body material
specs.value: ASTM A216 WCB · A105 · A352 LCB · A351 CF8M

specs.label: End connection
specs.value: Flanged · Butt weld (BW) · Socket weld · Threaded

specs.label: Actuator
specs.value: Manual (handwheel / lever) · Gearbox · Pneumatic · Electric
